propositions: test_pass_summary_reports_the_decline_count fails intermittently under xdist -n 3 --dist worksteal because a prior test in the same worker leaks the rebar_reconciler logger level to WARNING, suppressing later INFO assertions

the existing log integrity guard in tests/conftest.py hardcodes REBAR_LOGGER_NAME to a single root and does not cover the sibling rebar_reconciler root, leaving all rebar_reconciler.* INFO/DEBUG assertions vulnerable to level leaks

caplog.at_level(logging.INFO) without a logger= argument raises only the ROOT logger level, so INFO records are dropped by isEnabledFor at the originating rebar_reconciler logger before any handler is consulted

the per-item warning line in apply_inbound_records._inbound_unlink_one is emitted (proving confirm_store is not None), but the pass-summary info line at the tail of _inbound_update_apply_links is suppressed by the leaked WARNING level on rebar_reconciler

generalizing the log integrity guard to cover both rebar and rebar_reconciler roots via SHARED_LOGGER_NAMES and making the four primitives operate over the tuple fixes the order-dependent flake deterministically
